detail: Queries pin [out:json], where Overpass reports timeout/out-of-memory errors as HTTP 200 with a top-level JSON "remark" key — not '<remark>'. Such responses pass the guard, get cached, and the cache-first fetch never retries; bake+verify then pass deterministically, committing a silently empty/partial game asset.
recommended_fix: After decoding, json.loads the body and reject any response whose top-level object contains a "remark" key (keep the XML substring check too); also sanity-check a non-empty "elements" array before writing the cache file.
